property_summary: Calling setL1BlockValues from a non-depositor must revert and must not change any of C's public state variables; calling from the depositor address must update all public fields to the provided inputs.
Calling setL1BlockValues either reverts (if caller != depositor) leaving all public fields unchanged, or if it succeeds it atomically updates all public fields to the given inputs.
Calling setL1BlockValues never transfers Ether to the C contract (address(c).balance does not increase as a result of the call), regardless of inputs or whether the call reverts.

Only the designated depositor address can successfully call setL1BlockValues; for any caller other than DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT the call must revert, and when called by the depositor the stored fields match the provided inputs.
